authority.oda: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §2.11 describes R2004+ CMC as BS color index, BL RGB, RC color byte and says the index is always zero. §20.4.38 uses CMC for VIEWPORT ambient color. The two source objects below physically decode to a nonzero index; the source observation does not override the authoritative PDF.
authority.dxf: The DXF output here has group 63 for ambient color index and group 421 for RGB. No claim is made about consumer rendering or precedence from this comparison.

observations.source_values: LibreDWG decodes each ambient CMC with index 250, raw RGB/method 0xC2333333 and flags 0.
observations.output: Both corresponding ODA DXF VIEWPORTs carry group 63 = 250 and group 421 = 3355443. Both corresponding native strict DXF VIEWPORTs carry group 63 = 256 and group 421 = 3355443. The 88 model-space entity types and order also matched; no broad comparison claim follows.
observations.implementation: DRW_Viewport::parseDwg stores the raw field separately in ambientColorDwgIndex while getCmColor normalizes the public ambientColor when true color is present. writeViewport emits the public ambientColor for group 63.

disposition: Do not change output or claim incorrect rendering on this evidence. The source index conflicts with the authoritative CMC description. The retained raw index is mutable source metadata without an immutable snapshot tying it to all directly mutable public color fields; blindly emitting it after a caller edit could use stale state. Obtain authoritative meaning or an official correction, plus producer/consumer controls covering unchanged and mutated colors before selecting a bounded implementation. Retain caller compatibility and strict graph/output requirements.
limits: Two viewport instances in one local drawing and one ODA conversion; no native application rendering, interoperability parity, or consumer fallback claim. No external fixture is committed.
